plan_section: §4 R2 fail-close repair gate + §4.1 rejection cooldown + §4.2 conservative multi-leg

engine_failclose_tests.plan_§4_coverage: items 1-8, 10-11, 15-18 covered by Rust unit tests. Items 9 (portfolio reserve incl next-SO + fees + maintenance buffer), 12 (minQty/stepSize/tickSize/minNotional filter), 13 (maintenance margin breach => conservative liquidation), 14 (partial fill/reject policy) are exchange-modeling features that the corrected research engine approximates; full Binance maintenance/liquidation/filter is out of scope for research backtest (audit §3.5) and is required only at R11 production parity.

determinism_bug_fixed.bug: next_cycle_seq() used a process-global AtomicU64 that was never reset, so each binary invocation produced different cycle_ids => different trace hashes for the same config+bars. This broke backtest/live parity and made results non-reproducible.
determinism_bug_fixed.fix: Added reset_cycle_seq() called at the start of run_synchronized_cycle_replay, using a single shared static CYCLE_SEQ. Now same config + same bars => identical event/trade/equity/funding/rejection hashes across invocations.
determinism_bug_fixed.test: same_timestamp_nleg_order_is_deterministic verifies 5 consecutive runs produce identical event_stream_sha256

rejection_cooldown.mechanism: engine emits at most one atomic_reject event per (group, depth, reason) per decision boundary; permanent_config rejections (minNotional impossible / gross cap impossible) do not retry every bar
rejection_cooldown.classification: engine classifies min_notional_reject and gross_cap_reject separately; G1 gate uses unique rejection attempts not repeated bar counts

conservative_multileg.mechanism: engine evaluates all legs at the SAME completed-boundary timestamp; atomic reject when any leg fails min_notional/gross_cap (the whole layer is skipped, no partial fill). This is the conservative path; partial-fill/legging-loss modeling is an exchange-adapter concern for R11.
conservative_multileg.engine_path: sync_cycle_engine.rs lines ~700-715 (SO layer) and ~800-810 (FO layer): if any leg's layer_notional < 5.0 OR projected_group_gross > cap OR projected_portfolio_margin > equity => all_ok=false, layer skipped, sync_group_atomic_reject event emitted

build_status: cargo test + cargo build --release -p backtest-engine: 0 errors
conclusion: R2 PASSED. 14 fail-close tests (8 from ChatGPT audit + 6 new R19) all green. Determinism bug fixed (backtest reproducibility restored). Rejection cooldown and conservative multi-leg execution verified.
